title: mc_tasks::ManipulabilityTask
description: Drives the manipulability of a frame toward a target. The measure is Yoshikawa's velocity manipulability \(\sqrt{\det(\tilde{J}\tilde{J}^T)}\) of the frame Jacobian in frame coordinates, restricted to the selected axes and measure joints and normalized by the maximum frame and joint velocities. To maximize the manipulability, set a target above the reachable values or a positive reference velocity.

joints.description:
Joints whose Jacobian columns define the measure
If empty, every joint between the robot root and the frame but a floating base
Use activeJoints to select the joints that change the measure

axes.description:
Frame axes used by the measure, ordered as rotation then translation, a non-zero entry selects the axis
Defaults to all axes

target.description:
Target manipulability
Defaults to the current manipulability

maxTaskVelocity.description:
Maximum frame velocity along each axis, the Jacobian rows are divided by these values
Defaults to 1

useVelocityLimits.description: Use the robot velocity limits as the maximum joint velocities, the Jacobian columns are multiplied by these values

maxJointVelocity.description:
Maximum velocity of some measure joints (applied after useVelocityLimits)
Defaults to 1
